HARSHIT TRIPATHI Phone: +919035130434 | Email: ht1992@gmail.com Location: Gurugram, India | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/harshittripathi

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY Data Engineer with 10+ years architecting and leading scalable data platforms processing terabytes across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Databricks Certiﬁed Data Engineering Associate specializing in real-time streaming, ETL optimization, and data governance with proven impact: 60 percent deployment acceleration, 45 percent cost reduction, and 99.9 percent pipeline reliability. Expert in Databricks, PySpark, Python, Apache Spark, and cloud-native architectures delivering data solutions for 500+ enterprise users.

TECHNICAL SKILLS / CORE COMPETENCIES Languages & Frameworks: Python, PySpark, SQL, Spark Streaming, Delta Lake, Apache Kafka, Unix Shell Scripting

Big Data & Cloud Platforms: Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Live Tables (DLT), Unity Catalog, AWS (S3, Redshift, MWAA, Athena, Batch), Azure (ADLS, Data Factory, Synapse), GCP (BigQuery, Cloud Storage)

Databases & Data Warehouses: PostgreSQL, Oracle 11g/12g, MS SQL Server, BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, Azure SQL Data Warehouse

ETL & Data Integration: Databricks Delta Live Tables, Informatica PowerCenter, Informatica Cloud (IICS), CDC pipelines, Real-time streaming, Data pipeline development

DevOps & Orchestration: Apache Airﬂow, CI/CD pipelines, Harness, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Databricks Asset Bundles (DAB), Autosys, Apache Oozie, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform

Data Governance & Compliance: Unity Catalog, GDPR compliance, Data quality frameworks, Audit monitoring, Data lineage tracking

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Gurugram, India Publicis Sapient Senior Associate Data Engineering L2 July 2024 – Present • Led a core team of 6 associates in architecting and deploying a highly scalable Tier 1 platform to drive performance and

reliability

Architected Platform Data Product on Databricks (AWS/Azure) serving 500+ consumers with sub-second query latency through optimized Delta Lake architecture with Dremio integration

Engineered automated metadata extraction pipeline for 50+ Unity Catalog and non-Unity workspaces using Account API and Workspace Client API, improving governance visibility by 40 percent and eliminating 25 hours of monthly manual audits

Built end-to-end CI/CD pipelines with Harness and Apache Airﬂow orchestrating Databricks Asset Bundle (DAB) workﬂows, reducing deployment cycles by 99 percent from 4 hours to 2 minutes through automation via Copier templating

Designed Hive Sync Unity Catalog framework onboarding 15,000+ external Hive tables to Unity Catalog without manual monitoring requirements

Developed observability dashboards analyzing Unity Catalog system audit tables, monitoring 1 million+ daily queries for compliance, performance optimization, and cost tracking

Enquero (A Genpact Company) Manager - Data Engineering • Led Big Data ETL initiative on AWS Batch, orchestrating 15+ production pipelines processing 1.5TB daily retail

Gurugram, India March 2023 – July 2024

transactions with 99.9 percent accuracy and zero data loss through robust error handling

Implemented Slowly Changing Dimension (SCD) Type 1 transformation framework processing 50 million+ daily records from multi-source streams, achieving 35 percent faster processing through Delta Merge operations and efﬁcient partitioning

Designed comprehensive data quality validation strategy across 200+ Delta tables, achieving 99.8 percent data integrity through automated reconciliation between source and transformed datasets

• Loaded validated data onto Amazon Redshift using Copy Activity for end business consumption and analytics

Automated SFTP egress to third-party vendors using Python scripts, eliminating 120+ hours of monthly manual work and reducing transmission errors by 90 percent

Accenture Data Engineering Consultant • Architected real-time Spark streaming solution using Databricks and Apache Kafka with Informatica PowerExchange,

Gurugram, India July 2021 – March 2023

processing 500,000+ events hourly with less than 60 second latency for near-real-time data availability

Deployed streaming data pipelines with Slowly Changing Dimension (SCD-1) merge logic for PostgreSQL and BigQuery, synchronizing 8 production databases with 99.95 percent consistency through idempotent operations

Implemented Delta Live Tables (DLT) framework for streaming ingestion with automated data quality enforcement and lineage tracking, reducing data quality incidents by 75 percent through declarative pipelines

Publicis Sapient Associate Data Engineering L2 • Led enterprise Cloudera-to-Databricks migration of 100+ YARN jobs, 80+ Apache Oozie workﬂows, and 12TB Azure

Gurugram, India December 2019 – July 2021

Data Lake Storage (ADLS) data, completing 6 weeks ahead of schedule through parallel migration strategy

Built Dataset Migration Framework using Python automation, migrating 200+ tables (partitioned and non-partitioned) from production Azure Synapse database to UAT environment in 8 hours versus 1 week manual effort, achieving 98 percent time reduction

Designed push-down optimization framework for SQL Data Warehouse to ADLS extraction, boosting throughput by 50 percent and saving 15 hours weekly through predicate pushdown and parallel reads

Designed comprehensive ETL workﬂows for Global Commercial Operations using Informatica PowerCenter, Informatica Cloud (IICS), and Big Data Management (BDM), integrating 12+ data sources serving 500+ business users

Noida, India Tata Consultancy Services November 2015 – December 2019 Software Engineer - Data Engineering • Developed comprehensive ETL workﬂows for Global Commercial Operations using Informatica PowerCenter, Informatica

Cloud, and Big Data Management, integrating 12+ data sources serving 500+ business users

Automated GDPR compliance through personally identiﬁable information (PII) data masking scripts in Linux, eliminating 40 hours of fortnightly manual effort and ensuring 100 percent regulatory adherence across 10+ databases

Built real-time Medical Inquiry data exchange solution integrating third-party REST APIs via Informatica Cloud, reducing response latency by 70 percent from 15 minutes to 4 minutes

Resolved critical UTC-EST timezone discrepancies affecting 5 million+ records through custom transformation logic, ensuring accurate temporal data across 8 global time zones

EDUCATION Bachelor of Engineering in Electrical and Electronics Manipal University, Manipal, Karnataka, India

June 2011 – June 2015 CGPA: 8.30/10.0

CERTIFICATIONS • Databricks Certiﬁed Data Engineer Associate – Validated expertise in Databricks platform, Delta Lake, Apache Spark,

and data engineering workﬂows

AWARDS & RECOGNITION • Winner – AI & Data Center of Excellence Global Recognition 2025: Partnering for Client Impact

Silver Cheers Awardee (December 2023): Recognized for exceptional client impact and inclusive leadership

All Hands Star Award Nominee (March 2022, September 2022): Honored for delivering measurable business outcomes and client value creation

Account Recognition Award (March 2020): Celebrated for establishing UAT environment for Cloud Migration Project

On the Spot Awards (January 2019, February 2019): Acknowledged for successful GDPR Automation and Informatica Cloud Migration implementation
